_comment: Who may see which rows of the retail warehouse. Deployment configuration, not a domain fact, which is why it is here and not in semantic_layer.json. The grant keys must match a row policy's grant_key. Absent 'grants' for a key means the principal is not scoped by that policy at all; a key present with an empty list means scoped to nothing, which resolves to zero rows rather than to no filter.

principals.description: The default identity. Unrestricted, because every number this project has published was measured without row restriction.

Granted every region, and still filtered -- the predicate is injected and simply excludes nothing. Kept as a distinct principal from the steward because 'sees everything' and 'is not subject to the policy' are different states, and only the second one can silently start seeing a region added tomorrow.
Granted nothing. Reads zero rows -- the empty-grant case that must never degrade to an absent filter.
